title: Yet Another Client Modpack
description: Numerous client modifications while still preserving the authentic vanilla experience.
body:
<center>

# 🙚 𝗬𝖾𝗍 𝗔𝗇𝗈𝗍𝗁𝖾𝗋 𝗖𝗅𝗂𝖾𝗇t 𝗠𝗈𝖽𝗉𝖺𝖼𝗄 🙘
  
</center>

![Main Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/jtMEbEK6/images/9cbeb0599264a4f949cbb8376a01f3ed23350d8e.png)

The perfect balance between **performance** and **aesthetics**.

YACM is a lightweight modpack designed to enhance your gaming experience with quality of life improvements, subtle animations, tweaks, and embellishments.

<center>

## 🙚 𝚅𝚒𝚜𝚞𝚊𝚕𝚜 🙘

</center>

### 🙚  _Animations_  🙘
> #### _Doors, Trapdoors, Gates, etc._
  ![Fancy World Animations](https://i.imgur.com/tX1zGRp.gif)
  Change animation options in **_Esc_ > Mods > Fancy World Animations**

  
> #### _Eating Animations_
![Eating animations](https://i.imgur.com/XQCI2ip.gif)
 Change animations options in **_Esc_ > Mods > Eating animations**


> #### _Third-person Animations_
![Third-person animations](https://i.imgur.com/DW8SFw9.gif)
![Third-person item animations](https://i.imgur.com/3RbLvKC.gif)
Change third-person animations options in **_Esc_ > Mods > NotEnoughAnimations**

> #### _Inventory Particles_
![Inventory Particles](https://i.imgur.com/9DoNzuF.gif)
Change animations options in **_Esc_ > Mods > Inventory Particles**

> #### _Item Physics_
![Item physics](https://i.imgur.com/ikHod0z.gif)
Unfortunately, you can't change the config file from the mod menu; you can, though, disable the mod (**Item Physics Lite**) from the mods folder or change the options manually in the config folder.

> #### _Placing and breaking blocks_
![Placing and breaking blocks](https://i.imgur.com/dPFSs7C.gif)
Change animations options in **_Esc_ > Options > Fancy Block Particles**

> #### _Explosions_
![Explosion](https://i.imgur.com/P8F6VFm.gif)

### 🙚 _Textures_ 🙘

> #### _Glowing Ores_
![Glowing Ores](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6ef97d96086457d3a0a0f2c547f25456c08e78cc.png)
Disable the resource pack in **_Esc_ > Options > Resource Packs > (unselect NewGlowingOres)**

> #### _Round trees & Better leaves_
![Trees](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/abba1e4722dd81a402c619d2c70bba368b6f6d66.png)
![Round trees & Better leaves](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a40ed71596c0b0b11125eece6abe409abc973f91.png)
Disable the resource pack in:

**_Esc_ > Options > Resource Packs > (unselect Round-Trees)**

**_Esc_ > Options > Resource Packs > (unselect Better-Leaves)**

> #### _Dogs_
![Dogs from Better Dogs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eb907167ac992f3da5ec881e2f7401189d2f828f_0.webp)
You will only see the dog texture once you tame they.
Disable the resource pack in:

**_Esc_ > Options > Resource Packs > (unselect Better Dogs)**

> #### _Cats_
![Cats from better cats](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3a2e5617ad8cda82be2604e357d4887099aa6002_0.webp)
Disable the resource pack in:

**_Esc_ > Options > Resource Packs > (unselect Better Cats)**

> #### _Enchantment Books_
![Enchantment books](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/jtMEbEK6/images/466f074832e88f803abd04259a7a980e19c9270e.png)

<center>
